That's the power of Jokowi that has managed to make it work all these years. Jokowi managed to win the hearts of his political opponents so that there wasn't much resistance as long as he worked.
But the moves that Jokowi has been working on seem to be being addressed to. His political opponents one by one are now beginning to complain about Jokowi.
Volunteers today are not much to criticize and only focus on continuing to praise Jokowi. May Jokowi soon realise the danger.

As a sane citizen who once voted for Jokowi, we must realize that there are still many problems to be criticized from.
Intolerance issues, unexplained education, to still complicated and corrupt bureaucracy are some of the problems that have to be criticized. We are not choosing a new king for Indonesia right now.

Politics of democracy today is to choose workers who are based on tax management and all the potential in this country. As a political officer, Mr. Jokowi or whoever was chosen and given the power to work for the people.

I hope towards the end, Jokowi doesn't get caught up in forgetting himself because of the praise he keeps giving him. The heart calls to serve and to work hard to revive Jokowi to be upright on conscience.
2024 is entering the final stage. Jokowi will enter the last and greatest time of political leadership, which is to return to the people and restore the power that the people trust.
Jokowi may need to look back at Lord of the Ring.
On top of the story, the Ring bearer who got the mandate to break the ring was tempted by the power charm and became hesitant to destroy it.
May Jokowi not be tempted by personal political interests at the end of his office.
